S/O Shri Ravindra Singh ... on 21 March, 2023
Author: Sameer Jain

Bench: Sameer Jain [2023/RJJP/004537]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR  S.B. Civil Transfer Application No. 29/2020 Smt Khushbu @ Nikki W/o Shri Saurabh Singh D/o Shri Mahipal Singh Rathore, Aged About 32 Years, R/o 733/29, Peepali Ka Kua, In Front Of All Saint School, Dhola Bhata Road, Ajmer (Raj.)
 ----Petitioner  Versus Saurabh Singh S/o Shri Ravindra Singh, Aged About 35 Years,
R/o C-6, Kamal Apartment, Sawai Jaisingh Highway, Banipark,
Jaipur (Raj.)

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : None For Respondent(s) : None  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SAMEER JAIN  Order 21/03/2023 1.
None present on behalf of the parties.
The matter pertains to a matrimonial dispute and the law mandates that such cases should be disposed in a time bound manner.
2. No one is appearing on behalf of the parties on account of the ongoing lawyers strike.

However, as per the judgment of Apex Court in Harish Uppal Vs. Union of India (UOI) and Ors. reported in (2003) 2 SCC 45, this court is constrained to take up the matter for final disposal as per the pleadings, as the service in the matter is complete.

entities.text: Harish Uppal Vs. Union of India (UOI) and Ors. reported in (2003) 2 SCC 45
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Smt Khushbu @ Nikki W/O Shri Saurabh ... vs Saurabh Singh S/O Shri Ravindra Singh ... on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40059125/
1 3.

This transfer application has been filed by the applicant-wife under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure seeking transfer of Divorce Petition No. 4895/2019 titled as [2023/RJJP/004537] (2 of 3) [CTA-29/2020] 'Saurabh Singh Vs. Smt. Khushbu' filed by the non-applicant- husband under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 from Family court No. 1, Jaipur Metropolitan, Jaipur to Family Court, Ajmer.

entities.text: Family court No. 1, Jaipur Metropolitan, Jaipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Considering that the applicant is presently residing in Ajmer; that the applicant does not have the infrastructural support, in terms of family members, who can accompany her to court proceedings,
pending in Jaipur; that multiple proceedings arising out of the same marriage/matrimonial dispute are pending adjudication in District Ajmer, including cases under Section 498A, 406, 323, 354, 377 and 509 IPC, Section 125 of Cr.P.C. and Section 12, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22 and 23 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act; that the applicant is financially deprived with no independent source of income; that the applicant has the responsibility to look after her minor child; considering the provisions of Section 19 of the Hindu Marriage Act and relying upon the judgments of the Apex Court in N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha: Civil Appeal No. 4894/2022, Sumita Singh Vs. Kumar Sanjay & Ors.: AIR 2002 SC 396, Rajni Kishor Pardeshi Vs. Kishor Babulal Pardeshi: (2005) 12 SCC 237, and Vaishali Shridhar Jagtap Vs. Shridhar Vishwanath Jagtap: AIR 2016 SC 3584, this Court is inclined to allow the present transfer application.

sentences.text: 6. Both parties are directed to appear before the transferee court on 24.04.2023.
By that time, the record of the [2023/RJJP/004537] (3 of 3) [CTA-29/2020] case be transmitted to the transferee Court by the Court concerned.
It is made clear that if any of the parties would not appear on the date fixed by this Court, the transferee court would be at liberty to proceed in accordance with law.

7. It is expected that the transferee court shall dispose of the matter as expeditiously as possible;
preferably within the prescribed time period as stipulated in the Act.
8. Stay application and other pending applications, if any, stand disposed of.
9. Registrar (Judicial) is directed to supply a copy of this order to the concerned Court (Family court No. 1, Jaipur Metropolitan, Jaipur), forthwith, for necessary compliance.

4. Considering that the applicant is presently residing in Ajmer; that the applicant does not have the infrastructural support, in terms of family members, who can accompany her to court proceedings,
pending in Jaipur; that multiple proceedings arising out of the same marriage/matrimonial dispute are pending adjudication in District Ajmer, including cases under Section 498A, 406, 323, 354, 377 and 509 IPC, Section 125 of Cr.P.C. and Section 12, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22 and 23 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act; that the applicant is financially deprived with no independent source of income; that the applicant has the responsibility to look after her minor child; considering the provisions of Section 19 of the Hindu Marriage Act and relying upon the judgments of the Apex Court in N.C.V.
